attributes.title: Rack
attributes.lede: Six arrangements, one score, and a clock you can hold.

lesson.concept: A scrubbed score can visit several arrangements
lesson.why: The score includes intermediate arrangements, rather than starting a new layout pass for every notch. The transport samples that one score so reverse travel can visit the same poses.
lesson.experiment: Scrub slowly from letter order into the plotted arrangement, then reverse halfway. Track a single tile through the intermediate positions.
lesson.pitfall: Rebuilding a separate score at each notch introduces render gaps and makes quick scrubbing outrun the choreography.
lesson.combine: Combine with named build dependencies when the explanation needs both spatial arrangements and readable milestones.
